We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Administrative enforcement officers cleaning road, villagers obstruct. One villager (沈某乙) and others obstruct. Administrative staff tried to persuade, then forcibly removed them. Defendant 沈某甲 punched an enforcement officer 张某甲 on the head to stop them from pulling his uncle away, then left. He later turned himself in.

So the crime is assault on a public official performing duties. The list includes "妨害公务" (obstructing official duties). Also "故意伤害" (intentional injury). The act was punching head causing injury? Not specified if injury, but assault. The appropriate charge likely "妨害公务" (obstructing public duty) and possibly "故意伤害". In Chinese criminal law, assault on law enforcement is "妨害公务" if no serious injury, but if causing injury, could be "故意伤害". The list includes both. The scenario: He used a fist to hit the head. That is intentional injury. So "故意伤害". Also "妨害公务" because he obstructed law enforcement. The list includes "妨害公务". So we should list both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]故意伤害;妨害公务<eoa>
